author: Filmento
description:
The Great Wall is a 2016 international blockbuster where Matt Damon travels to China to help them fight alien monsters at the great wall. And it's a movie that defines a dark period in Hollywood: selling out to China. From Transformers to whatever, every movie was pandering to China to gain access to its markets. But then The Great Wall messed up so badly that Hollywood just gave up. So, since international projects are now more relevant than ever, let's see what went to wrong with this movie so badly to learn from its mistakes.
